verdict.rationale: Push-based sign-in with number matching is a fair axis for an authenticator app, but the evidence only documents TOTP/HOTP code generation, sync, transfer and a Privacy Screen. Nothing covers push approvals, number matching, location context or admin-enforced MFA policies.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
